newsitem.title: USA: U.S. March S&P 500s end down, but recover late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. March S&P 500s end down, but recover late.

text.p: Jan 8 - U.S. March S&P 500s closed lower, but recovered about 3.00 points in the final minutes of pit trade. Traders said hedge funds, which became extremely short during the sell-off, quickly covered positions. Traders said U.S. stocks followed declines in bonds, as both markets priced in strong gains in Dec payrolls data on Friday.
